entries.reason: These standard forms are value inputs rather than standalone persistent producer APIs in the checked-in public binding.
entries.evidence: No corresponding create entry point exists in PKToy parasolid.g.cs; vectors and axes are exercised as inputs to the analytic geometry and transform cases.
entries.recheckWhen: A persistent producer or transmit-owning entity for standalone vector/direction/axis values is added to the API inventory.

entries.reason: The option-bearing geometry transform returned a handle that could not be attached as persistent construction geometry in the tested runtime.
entries.evidence: PK_GEOM_transform_2 completed, but PK_PART_add_geoms for its returned point failed with error 22; no fixture was promoted.
entries.recheckWhen: The runtime clarifies ownership/lifetime of PK_GEOM_transform_2 output handles.

entries.reason: The checked-in runtime rejects the documented four-position open polyline standard form before a persistent polyline handle is returned.
entries.evidence: PK_PLINE_create returned error 5237 for distinct finite positions with closed=false and base_parameter=0; no geometry handle or x_t was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A runtime-compatible polyline parameterization and base-parameter convention are identified.
